unspecified_scores.reason: On every successful unlock (unlock/page.tsx:35 then :43) or setup completion (CompleteStep.tsx:58 then :62), the button turns enabled again and its label goes back from the loading text while window.location.href loads. On a home LAN this lasts only a moment. A second click in that moment sends a harmless extra unlock, or re-runs the setup writes just before the page is replaced.

specification_compliance: unlock/page.tsx:33-35 calls loadFullPage(resolveRedirect()) only when result.success is true. resolveRedirect (:19-25) accepts only paths that start with '/' and not '//'.
CompleteStep.tsx:46-58 calls loadFullPage('/admin') only after res.ok. The !res.ok branch returns before it.
fullPageLoad.ts:7-9 sets window.location.href, which loads the whole document again.

HEAD commit 35386f02: SetupWizard.test.tsx:497-499 first waits for the rejection message to appear and then asserts that complete-setup was not called and loadFullPage was not called. Without that wait, the negative assertion could pass before the async handler had run.
regression_risks: window.location.href does not add a Next.js basePath. None is configured today, but adding one later would break both redirects.

If complete-setup succeeds but the browser is slow to load /admin, the re-enabled Complete button lets the user re-run onBeforeSubmit after setup has finished. The setup token may then be rejected, so an error could show briefly before the page is replaced.
test_coverage: unlock/__tests__/page.test.tsx:45-59 checks the redirect target passed to loadFullPage for five inputs, and that router.push and router.replace are not used.
unlock/__tests__/page.test.tsx:61-78 checks that loadFullPage is not called for a wrong password or a network failure.

In SetupWizard.test.tsx, the tests at :474-504 (addon-policy rejected), :893-922 (password rejected) and :924-947 (drives rejected) check that loadFullPage is not called. The first two wait for the rejection message before asserting; the drives test also waits for its message.
No test asserts the button state after a successful navigation.
